groups.title: User groups
groups.subtitle: Decide who gets told when an alert is raised here.
groups.name: Name
groups.confirmDelete: Delete "{{name}}"? The people in it keep their accounts and access. Any alert rule still addressing this group will then reach nobody — deletion does not fall back to notifying everyone.

groups.noOwnerBody: Groups belong to a company, building, floor or zone. Pick one to see its groups.
groups.scopeNote: Groups defined at {{owner}}. Groups made further down the hierarchy are managed there.
groups.membersSubtitle: Who this group addresses. Membership is intent — access is re-checked whenever anything is sent.
groups.candidatesNote: Anyone at this location or above it can be added. Type to search — the list is shortened.
groups.noCandidates: Nobody here can be added to this group.
groups.noMembers: Nobody yet. A group with no members addresses nobody, and nothing is sent on its behalf.
